reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a procedural demonstration of swapping ETH for the FLUT token through Trust Wallet and Uniswap, without promising profits or claiming the token is legitimate. The description explicitly says the creator does not recommend investing and frames the material as a review or technical process, while the frames show wallet and swap screens rather than a deceptive benefit claim.

citations.quote: Firstly you will buy Ethereum Blockchain Click on BUY button and Here you will search ETH
Then click on Wallet Connect Then click on connect
Now here you will copy this address and paste here then you will click on this token

opening.argument: The practical solicitation is the acquisition itself: viewers are directed to buy ETH, connect a wallet, enter a token address, set slippage, and confirm a swap for FLUT. That is a complete participation pathway involving crypto assets, not merely discussion. The instructional sequence makes the requested purchase inseparable from obtaining the token, while the confirmation screen shows ETH being exchanged for FLUT. Even without an explicit profit promise, directing viewers through a token purchase can function as a solicitation for the token and expose them to the claimed asset’s risks.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material procedural does not answer what the procedure accomplishes. The cited wallet steps are precisely the mechanism for purchasing the token, and the confirmation screen depicts the exchange itself. A disclaimer that the creator does not recommend investing does not eliminate the practical effect of supplying a turnkey route to acquire FLUT.

I have only shared technical processes not financial advice

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The procedure establishes how to execute a swap, but it does not show appreciation, listing gains, dividends, or any promised return. The title and narration describe a technical purchase walkthrough, while the description expressly denies recommending investment and says the creator has not said the token is legitimate. The wrong-side argument turns the existence of a purchase path into a return-based scam claim without evidence of a return claim.

opening.argument: Several concrete risk signals appear together: the content directs viewers to crypto wallets and an external Telegram group, instructs them to paste a token address, and uses a 5% slippage setting before confirming the swap. Most importantly, the wallet screen itself warns that anyone can create a token, including fake versions of existing tokens. Against that warning, the process presents a token named Flute and a FLUT ticker for purchase without establishing authenticity. The combination of external contact, irreversible-looking crypto steps, token-address entry, and an explicit fake-token warning makes the presentation materially deceptive in effect, even though it avoids an overt guarantee.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats the screens as neutral interface demonstrations, but it does not account for the visible warning that fake tokens can be created. Nor does it explain why viewers are directed to an external Telegram group while being shown how to paste a token address and confirm a swap. Disclaimers do not cure the unresolved authenticity risk created by that combination.

The Telegram link is labeled for channel participation and promotion or collaboration, not as a payment or investment requirement. Risk indicators alone do not establish a scam subtype.

opening.argument: The educational label understates the content’s practical promotional function. The title is framed as “How to Buy” the token, and the narration walks viewers through every operational step needed to move from ETH to FLUT: connecting Trust Wallet, selecting the token, entering its address, and confirming the swap. The description also advertises a crypto-finance Telegram channel and a promotion or collaboration contact. Whatever disclaimer accompanies it, this is an actionable funnel toward token participation, not detached reporting about an asset.
